_comment: Stage-0 input for scripts/parallel-shard-runner.js --serial-config. Nothing reads this in CI. 'serial' commands run alone, before the parallel phase. 'reviewedSafe' records audit hits (node scripts/parallel-shard-runner.js --shard X --audit) that were read and judged harmless for parallel execution. The audit is a heuristic text scan, not a proof.
